lines.text: Your client just paid.
But only part of the invoice.
Twelve hundred of a two thousand dollar invoice just landed.
Three hundred has to stay in reserve.
Maya and Leo are both waiting to get paid.
So who gets what?
Meet Splitt.
lines.caption: Meet Splitt.

lines.text: Payment plans with a reason behind every amount.
An AI agent reads the invoice, the terms and the cash, and drafts the split.
Seven hundred to Maya. Two hundred to Leo, as his terms allow.
Then a separate rule engine checks every line.
Reserve.
Eligibility.
Caps.
Evidence.
Current state.
Nothing moves until you sign.
Your signature covers the exact batch. The vault, the payments, and the deadline.
Circle executes it.
Arc settles it.
And Splitt reconciles it from the chain.
When the rest of the money arrives, Splitt plans again.
Maya is already paid. Leo gets his final three hundred.
And the old approval can never be used twice.
Every project keeps its own cash.
One client's money never pays another client's bills.
And it's live today, on Arc testnet.
Three test vaults. Four batches executed through Circle. Every transaction on chain.
No paying customers yet. That's next.
Splitt.
Every amount has a reason.
Try it at use splitt dot x y z.
